title: Normalized t-exact comparison of entire truncation triangles
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be triangulated categories [def-weil-triangulated-category] with bounded t-structures [def-weil-t-structure]. Let $F:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be an exact functor preserving both halves in every integer degree, equipped with its coherent shift comparison $s_{K,r}:F(K[r])\xrightarrow{\sim}(FK)[r]$. For $m\in\mathbf Z$ let $U_K=\tau^{\le m}_{\mathcal C}K$, $V_K=\tau^{\ge m+1}_{\mathcal C}K$ and write the canonical distinguished truncation triangle [lem-weil-heart-short-exact-triangles] as $U_K\xrightarrow{\iota_K}K\xrightarrow{\pi_K}V_K\xrightarrow{\delta_K}U_K[1]$. Let $c^-_K:FU_K\simeq\tau^{\le m}_{\mathcal D}FK$ and $c^+_K:FV_K\simeq\tau^{\ge m+1}_{\mathcal D}FK$ be the unique natural comparisons [lem-pod-texact-truncation-comparison] satisfying $\iota_{FK}c^-_K=F(\iota_K)$ and $c^+_KF(\pi_K)=\pi_{FK}$.

The triple $(c^-_K,1_{FK},c^+_K)$ is the unique isomorphism of distinguished triangles from $F(U_K)\to FK\to F(V_K)\xrightarrow{s_{U_K,1}F(\delta_K)}F(U_K)[1]$ to the canonical truncation triangle of $FK$, with middle component $1_{FK}$. In particular its last square is
$$\delta_{FK}c^+_K=c^-_K[1]s_{U_K,1}F(\delta_K).$$
For any morphism $v:K\to L$ of $\mathcal C$, the triple $(\tau^{\le m}v,v,\tau^{\ge m+1}v)$ is a morphism of the canonical truncation triangles, so
$$\delta_L\tau^{\ge m+1}(v)=\tau^{\le m}(v)[1]\delta_K.$$
The comparison triples are natural in $K$ as isomorphisms of triangles. All equations are in the underlying triangulated categories and include the shifted last arrow, with precisely the specified $s$.

proof.text: For any competing triangle isomorphism beta with middle component the identity, apply Iso.ext and Mathlib TStructure.triangle_map_ext, the truncation uniqueness argument of lem-weil-heart-short-exact-triangles(1). The image source triangle is distinguished by F.map_distinguished and triangleLTGE_distinguished. Its first object is at most m by isLE_truncLT_obj and Functor.IsTExact.isLE_obj. The target triangle is distinguished and its third object is at least m+1 by the truncGE bound. The two middle components agree by hypothesis. Hence beta equals the constructed component.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q22-b48f5c640 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item and every cited node: heart-short-exact-triangles(1), triangulated-category (TR3 and the exact-functor shift iso), t-structure, and texact-truncation-comparison (the normalizations and naturality). I also read BBD Prop. 1.3.3(i),(ii) on printed pp. 29-30 of the local PDF. The statement is unchanged from the node Q25 created; I diffed the whole JSON. There are no new nodes, no SGA and no cycle; I walked the proof_deps closure, and the only citer is fixed-pair-truncation-cohomology. Step 1 is elementary: exactness makes the image triangle distinguished with last arrow sF(δ), and preserving both halves puts its outer terms in the right halves. Step 2 is correct: the unique iso over 1_FK is identified with c^- because composing with ι is injective by the right adjunction; for c^+ it applies the left adjunction to b(c^+)^{-1}, so it never cancels against F(π) directly; its last square is the claimed equation with no sign. Step 3 is correct: the TR3 third component equals τ≥v because both have the same composite with π_K and V_L lies in C^{≥m+1}; its last square is the boundary-naturality equation. Step 4 is correct: naturality of s plus Step 3 makes F(T(v)) a morphism of triangles, and naturality of α^∓ gives naturality of the triples componentwise. Edge cases K in C^{≤m}, K in C^{≥m+1}, K=0, F=0 and v=0 all hold. The boundedness hypothesis is kept although no step uses it, so nothing is weakened. This is not a duplicate: the comparison node lacks the boundary and triangle clauses, and eTruncGEδLT_comm covers only the boundary square. The one minor point, which I did not repair: Step 4 does not list def-weil-triangulated-category for the naturality of s, though that node is in proof_deps. No fixes, no tool_uses.
